newsletter.equities_text:
DayStarter, Vol. I, No. 59. Indian equities closed slightly higher on Thursday. The Nifty 50 closed at 24,647.50, up 0.09%, while the Sensex rose 0.19% to 78,727.29. The markets experienced a positive session throughout the day, supported by factors such as lower crude oil prices and optimism surrounding potential peace talks between the US and Iran.

Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) were net sellers of ₹943.42 crore on 5 August, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) bought a net ₹2,883.17 crore, continuing their strong support of the domestic market.
newsletter.f_and_o_text: In the derivatives segment, over 160 companies released their Q1 earnings today. Firstsource Solutions reported a 19% QoQ drop in net profit to ₹166 crore on revenue of ₹2,725 crore, leading to selective short buildups. Meanwhile, Garware Hi-Tech Films saw long accumulations after reporting a 62.2% YoY rise in net profit to ₹133 crore.
newsletter.commodities_text: Gold prices remained elevated in the domestic physical market, with 24K gold for 10 grams trading between ₹1,39,650 and ₹1,46,940 depending on local taxes and making charges. Brent crude stabilized near $82.50 per barrel, providing a slight tailwind for Indian macros.
newsletter.macro_text: The RBI continues to maintain its neutral policy stance with the repo rate at 5.25%. The USD/INR exchange rate hovered around ₹95.17 in early interbank trade with low volatility. Global equity markets sent mixed signals; Wall Street's Dow Jones hit a record high, while tech-heavy indices like the Nasdaq faced selling pressure.
news_updates: Trent Ltd's Q1 standalone net profit rose 26% YoY to ₹532 crore, with consolidated net profit standing at ₹518 crore.
Power Grid Corp reported a massive Q1 standalone net profit of ₹3,410.95 crore (consolidated ₹3,598.42 crore).
Blue Star's Q1 net profit slipped 15% YoY to ₹102.5 crore, even as revenue rose 13%.
Suven Life Sciences' net loss widened to ₹128 crore from ₹46 crore in the previous quarter.
Foreign Portfolio Investors turned net buyers in July 2026, investing approximately ₹20,200 crore into Indian equities after four consecutive months of selling.
regulatory_amendments: SEBI has concluded adjudication proceedings against Raghav Raj Kanoria, MD of India Power Corporation Limited, following a ₹24.7 lakh settlement regarding allegations of misstatements in financial records.
Encube Ethicals Limited filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) and abridged prospectus with SEBI.
SEBI continues to process various appeals and recovery proceedings, including notices issued in relation to past illiquid stock options cases.
